title: Jeremy
description: Jeremy is your great friend who will be there whenever you least need it!
body:
Jeremy is your great friend who will be there whenever you least need it!

He spawns around every 5 minutes, and beats the heck out of you, will you be able to survive his unending madness?


Here's all 7 variants so far:


Jeremy: Spawns around every 5 minutes.

Mathew: Needs to be crafted, doesn't do much.

ymereJ: Jeremy's twin brother, is completely harmless, his colors are inverted, spawns in Jeremy biome.

Evil Jeremy: Jeremy, but red and angry, has a 1 in 10 chance of spawning instead of normal Jeremy.

Jeremy's girlfriend: Also harmless, don't kill her, otherwise Jeremy will kill you on the spot, spawns in Jeremy biome.

Piss Jeremy: Self explanatory, spawns in the pissland.

Jeremy pig: Pig with jeremy's face, very aggressive, drops a very nice meat tbh, spawns in Jeremy biome.



This is so cursed. And I love it.
